reviewer: Codex visual assessment; independent human review pending
method: Five temporally ordered frames per five-second segment, approximately 0.1 to 4.1 seconds at 1 fps. Labels use visible content and position changes, not captions or similarity scores.

retrieval.run: Frozen pre-reingest raw VSS top five; not the UI parent-diversified top six

rubric.cyclist: A visible cyclist riding on an urban street; first-person filming is acceptable.
rubric.crossing: At least one pedestrian visibly traverses a marked street crosswalk.
rubric.traffic: A wide view establishes multiple highway lanes with vehicles visibly moving.

limitations: Three demo-selected broad queries, only 15 segments; not a held-out benchmark.
Several results show the same recording or location; relevance does not imply editorial diversity.
Sampled-frame assessment can miss brief events; this is not an independent full-video review.
No after-reingest result exists; no measured improvement is claimed.
